info.title: HBDS Graphic Simulator — Functor Navigation API
info.summary: Typed, read-only HBDS functor execution and query pipelines.
info.description:
Proposed navigation API contract grounded in François Bouillé chapters 10.1, 10.2 and 10.4 supplied by the project owner. Includes 141 catalogued functors, explicit per-functor POST operations, generic single execution, pipelines, expression parsing, name resolution, capabilities and immutable result pagination.

This contract is an ADDITIVE EXTENSION to the existing application. It does not assert that these routes are implemented and does not invent or replace the unknown request/response schemas of existing model CRUD, /ops, drafts, SSE, AI or documentation endpoints. See INTEGRATION.md for the exact supplied endpoint inventory and merge rules.

Source semantics and API engineering choices are separated in x-hbds-source, the functor catalog and SEMANTICS.md. Chapter 10.4 says its library is larger than the operations detailed in these slides; coverage here is complete for the identified named operations, not an unsupported claim to enumerate the whole historical HBDS implementation.

All execution reads one immutable saved/draft snapshot. TAD identity is preserved; TAD results are single (duplicate-free) lists. VAL returns value entries with provenance; SIGMA counts equal numeric values from different source attributes separately. Scalar output is terminal. Type-check complete pipelines before execution; never page intermediate stages. Bounded evaluation fails rather than silently truncating.

Bearer authentication and the normalized JSON adapter are proposed deployment contracts. The server MUST enforce model/draft/result authorization, input and parameter bounds, safe basename resolution and budget limits. No functor creates TADs, calls AI providers, changes model files or emits model-update events. All examples are synthetic contract examples, not retrieved live project data.

IntegerLexeme.description: Exact base-10 integer, encoded as a string to avoid JavaScript precision loss.

RealLexeme.description: Finite decimal/scientific-notation number; NaN and infinity are not allowed.

RationalValue.description: Exact rational number; denominator must be nonzero. Adapter normalizes sign and reduces by gcd. Nonzero is a runtime semantic constraint.

QuaternionValue.description: Components ordered scalar first, then the conventional imaginary basis coordinates; componentwise addition for SIGMA.

OctonionValue.description: Components ordered scalar first, then the conventional imaginary basis coordinates; componentwise addition for SIGMA.

ArrayValue.description: Flat row-major storage for vector/matrix/tensor; dimensions required and their product must equal item count. Lists omit dimensions and may contain heterogeneous/nested values. These are transport encoding choices.

GroupMember.description: Member attribute identity must match a class/object/hyperattribute or embryon attribute type. Same labels do not merge distinct members.

encoding.description: Versioned encoding identifier advertised by the adapter.

FuzzyValue.description: Chapter 10.1 names fuzzy forms but does not define a JSON encoding. payload is preserved losslessly under the explicitly declared encoding; this version does not apply SIGMA to fuzzy values.

ValueSelection.description: Standalone aggregation input. Verify every source reference and supplied value against the selected snapshot; reject stale or invented values. Repeated source identity is normalized; conflicting duplicate values are errors. Equal values from different source TADs remain separate.

ExecutionOptions.description: Defaults apply when absent. These are complete-evaluation budgets, not truncation controls. The server may advertise lower limits and rejects excessive requests. Pagination occurs only after the complete pipeline and aggregation. All TAD results are deduplicated by identity; numeric values are not deduplicated by numeric equality.

TraversalOptions.description: Direct is exactly one functor application. closure is a proposed HTTP extension only for catalogued composition/containment operations; it returns positive-depth descendants excluding seeds. EHCENSCall.description: Return hyperclass embryon TADs associated with the prefix set concept. No inverse is defined in the supplied chapter.

EHCENSRequest.description: Read-only EHCENS request. An omitted snapshot selects the current saved model atomically.

PipelineRequest.description: Typed pipeline. Validate ALL steps, including unreachable steps after an empty intermediate result, before execution. Adjacent element types must match. A scalar is terminal. Intermediate results remain complete and unpaged. This JSON form is canonical; arbitrary code is never accepted.

ResolvedStep.description: Normalized semantic plan. parameters have the schema of the named functor; a generic plan uses a map because heterogeneous steps have different argument schemas.

ValidationResponse.description: Successful type/reference/capability validation against the returned snapshot. No traversal or aggregate is evaluated. Runtime topology/resource errors can still occur during execute. Invalid queries return a 4xx Problem, never valid=true.

ExplainResponse.description: Read-only static execution plan; no invented cost estimates, side effects or query execution.

ParseBindings.description: Named bindings for the proposed bounded expression grammar. Its companion grammar document is not included in this snapshot; see README.md. No executable values. Identifier keys must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; the server validates this rule.

ParseRequest.description: Parse the documented navigation-expression subset and resolve/validate its names and types against a snapshot. Never eval, execute code, write models, fetch URLs, or call AI providers. Noncanonical source aliases require opt-in and produce warnings.

ParseResponse.description: Canonical executable AST. Snapshot is pinned with expectedRevision in the returned pipeline. Parsing validates but does not execute navigation.

ResolveRequest.description: Resolve qualified names to stable reference identities. No creation, fuzzy matching, URL resolution or model mutation.

FunctorDefinition.description: Contract metadata. This catalog does not claim that a running server implements the functor; consult model capabilities.

CapabilitiesResponse.description: Capabilities of the adapter and current saved model, not evidence that this proposed API is already deployed. Unsupported functors fail with 501; absent optional relationships on supported types produce empty lists. Drafts may have different data; execution validates the selected snapshot.
